title: NFL would address Troy Aikman's work for the Dolphins "at the appropriate time"

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL would address Troy Aikman's work for the Dolphins "at the appropriate time"
sources.description: Troy Aikman's apparent one-off consulting role with the Dolphins has resulted in Aikman recently saying he plans to continue working for the Dolphins "in some capacity."
